prompt:
Style: a walk-cycle sprite sheet for a 2D narrative role-playing game whose art is expressive oil painting. The figure is painted, not drawn: thick impasto with clearly visible, broad directional brushstrokes and palette-knife marks, built from a few large planes of colour, no line art, no cartoon outlines, no cel shading. The strokes stay broad and few so that the figure still reads at a small size on screen. Use the second attached image, an oil-painted portrait of the same character, as the only reference for the painting technique, brushwork and palette; use the first attached image only for the costume and the body proportions, not for its drawing style. Lighting: mid-light values, the figure front-lit from the upper left by a soft warm light, no backlight, no rim light, no glow around the figure; the clothes are clearly dark green (cap and vest), the shirt cream, the scarf red, the fur grey-black and white. The near leg and arm are painted a little lighter and warmer than the far leg and arm, so that both legs stay distinguishable. Avoid: smooth digital gradients, soft fur rendering, photorealism, a cute cartoon look, a plush toy or 3D-render look.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Sheet layout: the badger courier in strict side view (profile) walking to the right. One row of 6 animation frames of a walk cycle, evenly spaced, same scale, feet on the same baseline, the whole figure fully visible in every frame with clear empty space between the frames (the scarf ends never reach into the neighbouring frame). Phases: 1 contact, near leg forward; 2 down, weight on the near leg; 3 passing, the far leg swings forward past the near leg; 4 contact, far leg forward; 5 down, weight on the far leg; 6 passing, the near leg swings forward. The parcel stays under the arm nearer to the viewer; the scarf ends swing slightly behind. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no frame borders.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
